Details 
 An essential men's polo shirt with a defined fit. This short-sleeved shirt is crafted from stretch cotton piqué for natural, breathable comfort. The collar features subtle branding for a distinctive finish.
- Slim fit
- Neckline: Flat-knit collar
- Number of buttons: 3
- Short sleeves
- Standard length
- 92% Cotton, 8% Elastane
 Care
- Machine wash cold gentle cycle
- Do not bleach
- Do not tumble dry
- Iron at low temperature
- Do not dry clean
